top_findings: All pages dynamic and served with Cache-Control: private, no-store because SubscriptionBanner reads headers()/session in the root layout
No Organization, WebSite or SoftwareApplication schema; only one Article on the whole site
YMYL trust gaps: legacy brand names (simpleexpenses.ae, Smart Expenses, @simpleexpenses), no named team, unverifiable stats
Brand duplicated in feature-page titles; /features/expense-tracking title is 81 characters
quick_wins: Replace legacy brand names and emails
Remove lastModified: now from sitemap static routes

findings.title: Whole site dynamic and uncacheable
findings.description: Every page returns Cache-Control: private, no-store and X-Vercel-Cache: MISS from region iad1. Cause: SubscriptionBanner in app/layout.tsx reads headers() and the session.
findings.recommendation: Move SubscriptionBanner into app/(protected)/layout.tsx so marketing pages prerender and are CDN-cached.

findings.title: Sitemap lastmod always 'now'
findings.description: app/sitemap.ts sets lastModified: now for all static routes.
findings.recommendation: Omit lastModified for static pages; keep updatedAt for posts.

findings.title: Login page indexed and in sitemap
findings.description: /login is index,follow, has no H1, 75 words, priority 0.8.
findings.recommendation: noindex /login, remove it from the sitemap, add H1s to the auth pages.

findings.title: CSP blocks external images
findings.description: img-src allows only self, data:, blob: and google-analytics.
findings.recommendation: Host blog images in /public or allow-list the image host.

findings.title: No llms.txt
findings.recommendation: Optional; ignored by Google.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: Feature pages 848-2,057 words with UAE specifics
Blog post has a worked AED example

findings.title: No named people or company details (YMYL)
findings.description: About page has no founder or team names, bios, or legal entity details.
findings.recommendation: Add a team section with names, roles and LinkedIn, plus legal entity and emirate.

findings.title: Legacy brand names
findings.description: simpleexpenses.ae emails in 4 files, 'Smart Expenses' in PricingSection, @simpleexpenses twitter creator.
findings.recommendation: Replace all with Fixpenses equivalents.

findings.title: Unverifiable stats and testimonials
findings.description: '500+ UAE users' and 'AED 10M+ tracked' are hard-coded; testimonials lack attribution.
findings.recommendation: Use defensible numbers and attributed testimonials; no self-serving Review schema.

findings.title: Only one blog post
findings.recommendation: Publish 4-6 supporting budgeting posts linked to the pillar guide.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: One H1 per page on content pages

findings.title: Brand duplicated in titles
findings.recommendation: Remove brand from page-level titles.

findings.title: Overlong title
findings.recommendation: Shorten to under 60 characters.

findings.title: Generic titles on money pages
findings.recommendation: Add descriptive keywords.

findings.title: Homepage H1 lacks category term
findings.recommendation: Include 'expense tracker' / 'personal finance app for the UAE'.

findings.title: No og:image on 18 of 19 pages
findings.description: No opengraph-image file or metadata images.
findings.recommendation: Add app/opengraph-image.png.

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: Valid Article on the blog post with absolute image and ISO dates

findings.title: No Organization/WebSite schema
findings.recommendation: Add to root layout with logo, sameAs, contactPoint.

findings.title: No SoftwareApplication schema
findings.recommendation: Add FinanceApplication with AED offers on home and pricing.

findings.title: Article missing publisher.logo and author.url
findings.recommendation: Add logo and author page URL.

findings.title: No BreadcrumbList
findings.description: Feature and blog pages lack breadcrumbs.
findings.recommendation: Add BreadcrumbList JSON-LD.

categories.name: Performance (CWV)
what_works: CLS under 0.1 on all tested pages
Blog and pricing LCP around 2.2s on throttled mobile

findings.title: Homepage LCP poor on mobile (lab)
findings.description: 6.3s LCP on a throttled Pixel 7; 276 KB HTML, 247 KB JS, 1,051 DOM nodes; warm TTFB 0.8-1.2s.
findings.recommendation: Fix caching first, then trim client JS and RSC payload.

findings.title: Feature page LCP needs improvement
findings.recommendation: Re-measure after static rendering.

findings.title: Weak entity clarity
findings.description: Three brand names in use; no Organization schema.
findings.recommendation: Unify brand; add Organization schema with sameAs.

findings.title: Little citable depth
findings.recommendation: Build the budgeting cluster.

categories.name: Images
what_works: Blog image has alt text and is 56 KB

findings.title: No social preview images
findings.recommendation: Add opengraph-image.

findings.title: No modern formats
findings.recommendation: Serve WebP/AVIF via next/image for local images.

Replace legacy brand names and emails

items: Fix titles (dedupe brand, shorten, rewrite generic)

phases.name: Phase 3: Content & Authority
items: Named team, legal entity, author page

Monthly: indexation, impressions, CTR, mobile LCP p75
